preconditions.description: All inputs must be non-negative integers.
At least one jug must have a non-zero capacity.

postconditions.expression: result == True implies (z <= x + y and z % gcd(x, y) == 0)
postconditions.description: If the result is True, then the amount of water to be measured must be a multiple of the greatest common divisor of the capacities of the two jugs.

postconditions.expression: result == False implies (z > x + y or z % gcd(x, y) != 0)
postconditions.description: If the result is False, then the amount of water to be measured must exceed the sum of the capacities of the two jugs or not be a multiple of the greatest common divisor of the capacities of the two jugs.
